name: Remus Pharmaceuticals Ltd.
summary: Remus Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the marketing, trading, and distribution of finished dosage formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in India and internationally. The company's diverse product portfolio, exceeding 600 offerings, includes tablets, capsules, injections, creams, gels, eye drops, and various other dosage forms. Remus Pharmaceuticals focuses on therapeutic categories such as Critical Care, Oncology, Nephrology, Central Nervous System, Cardiology, Diabetics, Antibiotics, Immunosuppressants, Anti-inflammatory, Antifungal, Antipsychotic, Antiretroviral, Dermatology, Urology, and products for vitamin deficiency. The company primarily targets export markets, with significant operations in the Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, Latin America, and other emerging global markets. Leveraging an asset-light business model, Remus Pharmaceuticals collaborates with third-party and contract manufacturers, while also possessing manufacturing capabilities in India and the USA, to produce and distribute cost-effective generic alternatives. Additionally, the company provides technical and consultancy services for preparing product dossiers for international registration and engages in research and development for generic drugs and clinical trials.
